translationRepairs: Capable Officials — Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duo, Luwo, Yang Zunxu, and Wang Tang
Capable Officials — Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duoluwo, Yang Zunxu, and Wang Tang
s0001 lists six officials ending in 耶律鐸魯斡楊遵勖王棠; 耶律鐸魯斡 is one personal name (Yelü Duoluwo), not two people. The proposed reunification matches the Chinese.
Capable Officials ○ Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duo, Luwo, Yang Zunxu, Wang Tang
Capable Officials ○ Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duoluwo, Yang Zunxu, Wang Tang
The literal line likewise splits 耶律鐸魯斡 into Yelü Duo and Luwo; one name Yelü Duoluwo is required.

He reformed the magistrates of Liang Township, reduced corvée and labor service, devoted effort to farming and sericulture, built a Confucian temple and school, and the people of his district submitted to transformation.

He was reassigned as magistrate of Liangxiang, reduced corvée and labor service, devoted effort to farming and sericulture, built a Confucian temple and school, and the people of his district submitted to transformation.

s0021 改良鄉令 is career transfer into the magistracy of Liangxiang (良鄉令), not reforming plural township magistrates. The proposal’s sense is right, but “transferred to magistrate” is ungrammatical; “reassigned as magistrate of Liangxiang” is the accurate wording.
candidateDispositions: Edict phrase; Ma surname covered separately
